Name: Lilly's Delibird and Iron Bundle (Pokemon)
Author: Letsgolilly
Description:
Adds Delibird & Iron Bundle as Barn Animals.
Both can be purchased at Marnie.
If you are lucky you might buy a shiny one.
They will give you presents at night.
Those presents can be opened in the Present Opener.
Each present contains different items.

[list]
[*]Presents contain low value items and some may have an explosive surprise.
[*]Gifts contain animal products and items from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24376]Tinkaton[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24418]Ribombee[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29334]Skitty[/url] mod if installed.
[*]﻿Mystery Gifts contain high value items
[*]Surprise Gifts are disabled by default but give totally random items.
[*]You might receive something special on the ﻿Feast of the Winter Star.
[/list]

You can get Dolls of Delibird & Iron Bundle if you download my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29334]Skitty[/url] mod.
